content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm unable to connect my [product_name] [article_no] to my computer. I'm using [product_name] [version_no], running on Windows 10, and my device is [product_name] [article_no]. I keep getting some error messages. Any assistance would be appreciated.

It appears you're encountering an issue related to Java. Have you checked whether your Java installation is up to date? If not, consider updating Java. Also, upgrading [product_name] to the latest version [version_no] is recommended. You can find the free update in the software upgrades section. Note that both 32-bit and 64-bit versions are available. After downloading, you'll have a file called 'Setup.exe.' Run this as administrator and follow the prompts.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing difficulty connecting their [product_name] [article_no] device to a PC using [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 10. A potential Java issue indicates that necessary software dependencies may not be correctly managed or communicated, resulting in confusion over compatibility among software, hardware, and Java runtime requirements. There is also uncertainty regarding selecting the appropriate software version based on the OS bitness and the installation procedure.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward connectivity between the [product_name] controller and their PC with the provided software on Windows 10, as well as clear and actionable error messages if any problems arise.
